name: toby-desktop
description: Your local team of AI agents on Mac.
author: Rohan Pahwa

scripts.build: electron-vite build && bun build src/main/mcp-stdio.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile out/main/mcp-stdio.cjs && swiftc packaging/computer.swift -O -o resources/computer-helper
scripts.test: bun test && bun build tests/store.node.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile .local/store-test.mjs && node --test .local/store-test.mjs

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Toby requests microphone access only when a supported voice-input integration is available and you choose to use it.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Toby only uses camera access when you explicitly allow a website to use it.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Toby needs Screen Recording permission to understand your screen when you request computer assistance.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Toby uses System Events only when you approve an action to understand or control this Mac.
